steps.name: prompted-task-events-only
steps.detail: Pre-case: `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at11-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at11 atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"clear-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","cleared":false}. Assigned three tasks: `atm task assign fx-at11-beta "AT11 case1 task1" --task-id at11-1789404006-1 --json` -> {"task_id":"at11-1789404006-1"}; task2 --task-id at11-1789404006-2 -> {"task_id":"at11-1789404006-2"}; task3 --task-id at11-1789404006-3 -> {"task_id":"at11-1789404006-3"}. Polled `atm task events at11-1789404006-1 --json` every 5s (iters 1-14, ~68s): handoffs reached [task_queued@16:40:06.309Z, task_ready@16:40:06.722220870Z, task_reminder@16:41:11.717346860Z] and events list showed assigned(seq1)->reminded(seq2, task_ready)->reminded(seq3, task_reminder). Observed interval = 16:41:11.717346860Z - 16:40:06.722220870Z = 64.995s (~65s, matches documented 60s default + scheduling margin). Started task 1: `atm task start at11-1789404006-1 "starting task 1" --json` -> {"action":"send",...,"task_id":"at11-1789404006-1","summary":"starting task 1"}. Re-ran `atm task events at11-1789404006-1 --json`: events now [assigned(seq1,16:40:06.309Z), reminded/task_ready(seq2,16:40:06.722Z), reminded/task_reminder(seq3,16:41:11.717Z), started(seq4,16:41:23.769569877Z, actor fx-at11-beta, to_state active)]; handoffs show task_queued, task_ready, task_reminder, task_started in that order -> queued, ready, reminder, started confirmed in order. `atm task events at11-1789404006-2 --json` -> events=[assigned only], handoffs=[task_queued only]. `atm task events at11-1789404006-3 --json` -> events=[assigned only], handoffs=[task_queued only]. Tasks 2 and 3 show queued only, as required.
